P_0x00E3E4: Read as "Kanan." An immortal of Baral. Calm in manner but very proud, both her appearance and bearing are masculine, hiding an inner fierceness. She does not scorn humans; rather, she feels a duty-bound need to show the way to her much younger siblings, who still fail to grasp the way of things. Before her shikai (shedding the human body to become an immortal), she was a beauty in men's clothing. Full name: Kanan Jun.
P_0x00E658: Read as "Taihou." An immortal of Baral. A person who basically affirms everything with "Well done, well done," having realized that resisting or submitting, living or dying, are all equally without purpose. He acts as Kanan's mentor, and while accepting her every word and deed with the same "Well done, well done," he treats her like his own daughter. Full name: Taihou Sandayu.
P_0x00E82D: Read as "Hou." A beast-immortal (fox immortal) of Baral. Once saved by Taihou, she has followed him as her teacher ever since. She serves as Baral's information gatherer, using summoning talismans to call forth and command demonic mechanical beings. Calm and gentle in manner. Full name: Houkason.
P_0x00E9A9: A pilot among the Neue DC remnants. He once took part in Operation Plantagenet alongside Van Ba Chun, leader of the Neue DC, and was scarred on the face during an Einst attack in that operation.
P_0x00EABE: A mercenary hired by Isurugi Heavy Industries. Even in battle he shows no hatred or hostility, fighting with cool detachment, but at heart he is cold-blooded and cruel.
P_0x00EB6B: A member of the Schtedonias Army's special operations unit and Zamboss's adjutant.
